text:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: primary-gpu-pool (us-east1) queue length > 1200, avg wait 14s, autoscaler error rate increased. Priority: P1.

Alice W: Seeing large queue growth in us-east1, autoscaler logs show repeated "error: quota exceeded" for create-instances.
Ben O: Confirmed. Autoscaler is hitting our project GPU quota. Quota request to cloud in progress but will take 2+ hours.
Chao I: Queue is sticky in a subset of frontends — looks like session affinity is causing requests to stick to the hot nodes.
Lisa S: Paging oncall now. @Ben O you take primary ops. I'll start coordination with routing.
Ben O: @Lisa S on it. Running quick check: `kubectl get hpa -n serving primary-gpu-pool -o yaml` shows desired replicas 60, available 12, pending creates 48 with failed jobs.
Chao I: snippet from logs: ```autoscaler: failed to create vm: quotaExceeded: "GPUS v1"``` Also seeing `sticky_cookie=true` on route entries for a high-volume customer group.
Jordan S: Support reports multiple enterprise customers in EU and NA reporting 502/504s and slow token generation. Not full outage, but heavy degradation.
Alice W: Important - the traffic source mix is ~70% small gen requests, 30% long chat streams. Small gens are stuck behind long-lived streams due to affinity.
Ben O: Immediate mitigation proposals: 1) Turn off session affinity on path /v1/generate for all non-LLM-stream routes, 2) Throttle low-priority keys to 20% of baseline, 3) Enable cross-region overflow to eu-west1/cpu-fallback. Which can we do now?
Chao I: I can push affinity toggles now. Changing `sticky_cookie` to `none` for route table entry will rebalance new requests but won't drain existing KV caches. We'll see churn.
Lisa S: I'll prepare a routing roll that adds eu-west1 as overflow for short requests only. That should reduce pressure on us-east1 for small gens.
Ben O: Execute steps: (1) @Chao I remove affinity. (2) @Lisa S flip overflow policy. (3) @Jordan S send customer impact note.
Chao I: Running command: ```curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/routes/modify -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","affinity":"none"}''``` -> 200 OK. Changes taking effect.
deploy-bot: :robot_face: Routing config deploy started by Chao I — deploy id deploy-2485-R2.
Ben O: Throttling low-priority API keys via rate-limiter: toggled `priority:low -> rate=0.2` in redis config.
Lisa S: Pushing overflow: added eu-west1 as overflow target with `max_request_tokens=1024` and `sticky=false` for short paths.
incident-bot: INFO: overflow routing enabled -> eu-west1 (short-paths only). Spillover threshold lowered from 70% to 55%.
Jordan S: Sent initial customer-facing note: "We're experiencing elevated latency in generation in some regions; engineers are actively mitigating by redistributing load and throttling non-critical workloads. Updates every 15m." (sent to affected accounts).
Alice W: After affinity removal, new connections are distributing but KV cache misses increased which briefly raised latency on existing streams. Expected.
Ben O: Autoscaler backlog reduced from 48 pending creates to 8 after routing changes — quota errors still present for further scale.
Chao I: Observing a secondary issue: because of sticky sessions being removed, a bunch of long-stream requests are now reconnecting to eu-west1 which doesn't have matching model quantization -> some variant mismatch 400s. Rolling a lightweight compatibility shim in eu-west1 to serve fallback variants.
Lisa S: Temporary rule: route long-stream requests to us-east1 only if model_version == v2. Otherwise route to cpu-fallback in eu-west1. Implemented via routing predicate.
Ben O: Good. Also enabling manual burst capacity: adding reserved nodes from our cold-pool to us-east1 (will increase costs but reduces customer impact). Chao — can you handshake those nodes?
Chao I: Cold-pool nodes assigned, starting warmup. Some instances will take ~90s to be ready. Init logs: `gpu-init: ok`, `kv-load: partial` because of version mismatch — will accept degraded quality temporarily.
Jordan S: Support update sent: "We have dynamically redistributed traffic and are bringing additional capacity online. Some requests may experience reduced fidelity while we stabilize."
Alice W: Metrics: queue length dropping from 1200 -> 260 over 10 minutes. Median latency down from 5.6s -> 1.4s for short gens. Long streams still recovering.
Ben O: Important customer impact note: two enterprise customers saw >5% request error spikes for ~18 minutes. We'll include in RCA.
Lisa S: Oncall handoff at +30m. @Ben O please document actions taken and hand to @Lisa S for next shift.
Ben O: Documenting timeline now in /incidents/ops/2485000000 notes. Key mitigations: affinity off, overflow to eu-west1 short paths, throttle low-priority, cold-pool add, compatibility shim.
Chao I: Follow-ups I see: 1) Remove sticky routing entirely from new deployments unless flagged, 2) Add automated health-checks for quantization variant mismatch in overflow targets, 3) Pre-authorize emergency GPU quota with cloud provider.
Jordan S: Customers want ETA on full restoration. ETA: 60-90m for full quality restoration given warmup and model sync.
incident-bot: Pager: oncall shift change scheduled — paging Lisa S for takeover.
Lisa S: Taking over. I'll validate evictions and ensure no long tail. Ben, please drop a note in the handoff with any open actions.
Ben O: Handoff posted. Leaving now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Lisa S: Post-mortem notes (prelim): root cause = sticky routing + quota-constrained autoscaler; contributing = lack of model-variant checks in overflow targets, no emergency reserve quota. Action items: (a) routing defaults audit, (b) emergency quota runbook, (c) autoscaler retry/backoff improvements, (d) alert tuning for queue growth vs transient KV churn.
Chao I: I'll file infra JIRA tickets for (a) and (b).
Jordan S: I'll prepare the customer follow-up message with impact summary and mitigation timeline.
Alice W: Marking thread status -> mitigated. Will reconvene for RCA.
Lisa S: Closing oncall. If anything pops, re-open thread. :lock:
